title: Japan 20-Year JGB auction (¥700bn reopening of issue 197) — the same date as the US 20Y reopening
source: EST: mof.go.jp English announcement 'Announcement of 20-Year JGBs to Be Issued in September' (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/announcement/auct20260908e.htm), re-fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 19,606 bytes) — dated September 8, 2026 and reading verbatim auction date September 15, 2026, issue date September 16, 2026, maturity date June 20, 2046, offering amount 'About 700 billion yen', with the footnote '20-year JGBs to be issued in September will be a reopening issue of the July 2026 issue'. Corroborated by MOF's own September 2026 auction calendar (calendar/2609e.htm, same session), which lists the 09-15 20-year alongside a 09-10 Liquidity Enhancement (1-5y), the 09-25 Liquidity Enhancement (5-11y), the 09-29 40-year and the 09-30 2-year. The bond being reopened is identified from a third MOF primary, the Auction Results for JGBs workbook (english/policy/jgbs/auction/past_auction_results/Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls, downloaded 2026-09-08): issue 197, 3.7% coupon, maturity 2046-06-20, first sold 2026-07-14 and reopened once already on 2026-08-20. Stays `estimate` on one mechanical count, not on date doubt: market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:), the same limit ecb-decision-2026-09-10 and boj-decision-2026-09-18 both recorded. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: Discovered during the treasury-30y-bond-2026-09-10 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-08) while testing whether that ledger's 'synchronized global long-end move' leg is narrative or calendar; researched 2026-09-08 (docs/research/events/jgb-20y-auction-2026-09-15.md). It is calendar: Japan and the United States both sell 20-year duration on 2026-09-15, the day before the FOMC, and Japan's result publishes during the Tokyo session (09:00-15:00 JST = 20:00 ET 09-14 to 02:00 ET 09-15) — hours BEFORE the US 20Y's 1:00pm ET stop. Tiered `low` and NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED: no house playbook is rates-keyed and no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure. The initial research tested the spillover directly and returned a null — across 44 JGB 20Y auctions 2023-01 to 2026-08, a soft auction (tail >= 2bp, n=14) preceded a +1.43bp mean US 20Y CMT move on the same date vs -0.10bp for firm ones (n=30), diff +1.53bp against a 4.99bp daily standard deviation, t=+0.80; corr(tail, US 20Y change) = +0.174. Sign consistent, magnitude noise. What the entry buys is therefore attribution, not signal: a 09-15 long-end move is not automatically the US auction's. Two related MOF dates are recorded here rather than filed, being adjacent to nothing this calendar tracks: the 09-10 Liquidity Enhancement (1-5y, front end) and the 09-25 Liquidity Enhancement (5-11y). The 09-29 40-year IS filed, as a proposal, because it is the next read on the same super-long demand question. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
